2: An instruction, by Ethan the Ezrahite. Of the kind acts of Jehovah, to the age I sing, To all generations I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth,
3: For I said, `To the age is kindness built, The heavens! Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness in them.'
4: I have made a covenant for My chosen, I have sworn to David My servant:
5: `Even to the age do I establish thy seed, And have built to generation and generation thy throne. Selah.
6: and the heavens confess Thy wonders, O Jehovah, Thy faithfulness also is in an assembly of holy ones.
7: For who in the sky, Compareth himself to Jehovah? Is like to Jehovah among sons of the mighty?
8: God is very terrible, In the secret counsel of His holy ones, And fearful over all surrounding Him.
9: O Jehovah, God of Hosts, Who is like Thee--a strong Jah? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.
10: Thou art ruler over the pride of the sea, In the lifting up of its billows Thou dost restrain them.
11: Thou hast bruised Rahab, as one wounded. With the arm of Thy strength Thou hast scattered Thine enemies.
12: Thine are the heavens--the earth also is Thine, The habitable world and its fulness, Thou hast founded them.
13: North and south Thou hast appointed them, Tabor and Hermon in Thy name do sing.
14: Thou hast an arm with might, Strong is Thy hand--high Thy right hand.
15: Righteousness and judgment Are the fixed place of Thy throne, Kindness and truth go before Thy face.
16: O the happiness of the people knowing the shout, O Jehovah, in the light of Thy face they walk habitually.
17: In Thy name they rejoice all the day, And in Thy righteousness they are exalted,
18: For the beauty of their strength art Thou, And in Thy good will is our horn exalted,
19: For of Jehovah is our shield, And of the Holy One of Israel our king.
20: Then Thou hast spoken in vision, To Thy saint, yea, Thou sayest, I have placed help upon a mighty one, Exalted a chosen one out of the people,
21: I have found David My servant, With My holy oil I have anointed him.
22: With whom My hand is established, My arm also doth strengthen him.
23: An enemy exacteth not upon him, And a son of perverseness afflicteth him not.
24: And I have beaten down before him his adversaries, And those hating him I plague,
25: And My faithfulness and kindness are with him, And in My name is his horn exalted.
26: And I have set on the sea his hand, And on the rivers his right hand.
27: He proclaimeth me: `Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.'
28: I also first-born do appoint him, Highest of the kings of the earth.
29: To the age I keep for him My kindness, And My covenant is stedfast with him.
30: And I have set his seed for ever, And his throne as the days of the heavens.
31: If his sons forsake My law, And in My judgments do not walk;
32: If My statutes they pollute, And My commands do not keep,
33: I have looked after with a rod their transgression, And with strokes their iniquity,
34: And My kindness I break not from him, Nor do I deal falsely in My faithfulness.
35: I profane not My covenant, And that which is going forth from My lips I change not.
36: Once I have sworn by My holiness, I lie not to David,
37: His seed is to the age, And his throne is as the sun before Me,
38: As the moon it is established--to the age, And the witness in the sky is stedfast. Selah.
39: And Thou, Thou hast cast off, and dost reject, Thou hast shown Thyself wroth With Thine anointed,
40: Hast rejected the covenant of Thy servant, Thou hast polluted to the earth his crown,
41: Thou hast broken down all his hedges, Thou hast made his fenced places a ruin.
42: Spoiled him have all passing by the way, He hath been a reproach to his neighbours,
43: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries, Thou hast caused all his enemies to rejoice.
44: Also--Thou turnest back the sharpness of his sword, And hast not established him in battle,
45: Hast caused him to cease from his brightness, And his throne to the earth hast cast down.
46: Thou hast shortened the days of his youth, Hast covered him over with shame. Selah.
47: Till when, O Jehovah, art Thou hidden? For ever doth Thy fury burn as fire?
48: Remember, I pray Thee, what is life-time? Wherefore in vain hast Thou created All the sons of men?
49: Who is the man that liveth, and doth not see death? He delivereth his soul from the hand of Sheol. Selah.
50: Where are Thy former kindnesses, O Lord. Thou hast sworn to David in Thy faithfulness,
51: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Thy servants, I have borne in my bosom all the strivings of the peoples,
52: Wherewith Thine enemies reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached The steps of Thine anointed.
53: Blessed is Jehovah to the age. Amen, and amen!
